working: Over a full cycle ΔU = 0, so the net heat supplied equals the net work done, which is the area enclosed by the loop. The cycle runs clockwise, so this work is positive. W = (300 − 100) N/m² × (5 − 2) m³ = 200 × 3 = 600 J. As a check, heat absorbed only on d→a and a→b is 600 + 2250 = 2850 J, which is not an option. So 'total heat' here means the net heat, 600 J.
